U1_thermal_EP.assessment: Two external tented GND vias and 0.30mm F.Cu links contact filled In1 plane. No local F.Cu GND pour exists. Electrical ground continuity confirmed; narrow thermal paths and enclosure temperature require physical qualification, no datasheet JEDEC thermal resistance is assumed.
U1_thermal_EP.tenting_evidence: Native .kicad_pcb via UUID50716e6b… and f997792a… explicitly contain front yes/back yes; global hole-to-paste audit zero overlaps.

via_smd_paste_audit.audit_method: All through-via circular drill holes versus every SMD copper and paste shape on both sides, including same-net. Native rounded/custom pad shapes; paste uses ClonePad resized by loaded GetSolderPasteMargin(layer), including ratio. Includes standalone EP paste apertures. Uses native Collide(point, drillradius) for overlap and binary search of Collide(point, drillradius+gap) to 1nm for nominal edge clearance; SHAPE.Distance is deliberately not used. All loaded paste margins are zero or negative; holes are also checked against the unshrunk native copper/aperture envelope, so no conclusion depends on assuming a reduced corner radius. Nominal CAD geometry only; fabrication/registration tolerances are separate.

findings.detail: C3 relocation had placed its GND drill hole over its SMD copper/paste. Moved only GND via to(57.8,92.1) and extended one existing F.Cu track; native DRC/parity/opens zero.

Original U5 via→C15/C16 In2-only routes were28.02193/31.14411mm via y59.55 despite sharing one plane island. Accepted one0.30mm B.Cu bridge between existing power vias closes a local U5–C15 bypass in2.469mm XY plus two existing vias. C15–C16 has a3.57782mm local In2 route. U3/U4/U7/U8 local saved-copper routes separately verified.
U1 EP has working external thermal vias and In1 plane, but no F.Cu thermal pour. Do not apply JEDEC board thermal numbers or declare safe enclosure temperature without test.
